**Notations:** `Ajnana -> Samsaya -> Jnana -> Buddhi -> Karma`, `J:(K_t,Doubt_t)->(K_{t+1},Doubt_{t+1})`, `K_t=(X_t,Sigma_t,Pi_t,Gamma_t,Delta_t)` · **Aliases:** `Chapter 4 doubt/knowledge/action reading`, `KERNEL-CANDIDATE-v1 freeze proposal`

Note: Rereads Gita Chapter 4 (Jnana Yoga, doubt destroyed by knowledge) against the completed Chapters 5-18 model, adding the missing layer of how the kernel transforms knowledge and resolves doubt. Proposes a five-component knowledge state K_t=(X_t,Sigma_t,Pi_t,Gamma_t,Delta_t) [content, epistemic quality, provenance, context, detected gaps]. Proposes a five-operator formal algebra Omega(observe),Q(qualify),J(know/transform),B(discriminate),A(act) with explicit composition K_{t+1}=J(Q(Omega(W_t)),K_t), D_t=B(K_{t+1},C_t), W_{t+1}=A(D_t,W_t). Closes by proposing to freeze a KERNEL-CANDIDATE-v1={K_t,Zero,Samsaya,Jnana,Buddhi,Decision,Action} and mathematically test operators J,B,A,Omega,Q for closure/typing/identity/composition/reversibility/monotonicity/information-loss before continuing to add Gita terminology.

Note: Rereads Gita Chapter 3 (Karma-yoga) after Chapters 4-18, deriving mechanisms for constructing/simulating the kernel rather than treating it as analogy. Introduces the hierarchy Soul>Buddhi>Manas>Indriya>Objects, refining Kernel~Mind into Kernel~Manas+Buddhi operational system (two distinct functions, Manas=state-processing, Buddhi=discrimination). Gives a control-loop model W_t->O_t->M_t->B_t->A_t->K_{t+1}. From the false-agency verse (3.27), proposes 'Kernel must distinguish operation from operator' -- the system must not confuse 'I produced this result' with 'this operation produced this result under these conditions', with strong implications for provenance/attribution/auditability. Proposes a kernel safety invariant Buddhi(x) != Buddhi(x|unexamined attachment), i.e. Discern->CheckBias->Qualify->Decide, explicitly not proof of the Qualify operator, only motivation. Major refinement: Zero(K_t) = Missingness + Distortion, Z_t=(G_t,D_t) (ignorance vs corruption of already-present but distorted knowledge) -- flagged as requiring a corpus test before adoption. Gives Svadharma->Operation applicability subset Type(OperationContext), connecting to the existing Admissible concept. Proposes progressive-not-destructive knowledge transformation (detect misconception->introduce evidence->discriminate->reconcile->transition, not delete-and-replace). Gives a 12-operator candidate catalogue (Receive,Attend,Compare,Discern_B,Accept,Reject,Hold,Transform,Act,Observe-consequence,Reconcile,Purify) and a candidate kernel state (fraktur K)_t=(M_t,B_t,K_t,Sigma_t,G_t,D_t,Gamma_t) with transition algebra (fraktur K)_t-Omega->O_t-M->M_{t+1}-B->B_{t+1}-Q->Q_t-A->a_t-delta->K_{t+1}.
